title: Policy leaderboard
description: Reported performance of the evaluated persona-conditioned policy configurations.

boards.title: Strict-success leaderboard
boards.description: 100 tasks · 217 authored persona cases · privileged state and goals · assisted skills · no RGB
notes: Success requires the native persona goal, physical nonfixture evidence, valid and faithful execution, no timeout and no controller error.
Trials are averaged within observed personas, personas within each task, and all 100 tasks equally. Infrastructure outcomes remain unscored.
Trial counts, reasoning effort, budgets, harness revisions and recovery procedures differ; ordering is descriptive.
Point estimates follow the paper snapshot. Study protocols, coverage and archived count evidence are available in the downloadable results.

rows.protocol: High reasoning · 3 trials/persona · seeds 100–102 · Codex CLI · 64 assisted actions
rows.notes: Three trials per persona, 651 scored episodes. The study includes disclosed recovery continuations and selected simulator repairs.

rows.protocol: High effort · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Messages API · up to 10 decisions / 64 skills
rows.notes: 682 strict successes / 2,050 scored; 120 infrastructure slots are unscored. Three personas have no scored trials and are excluded from observed means.

rows.protocol: High effort · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Claude Code · tools disabled · up to 10 decisions / 64 skills
rows.notes: 668 strict successes / 2,138 scored; 32 infrastructure slots are unscored. All 217 personas have at least one scored trial.

rows.protocol: Medium reasoning · 10 trials/persona · privileged state and goals · 64 assisted actions · no RGB
rows.notes: Task-balanced strict success from the current CoRL paper figure, using the shared privileged assisted skill interface.

rows.protocol: Medium reasoning · 1 trial/persona · seed 100 · Codex CLI · 64 assisted actions
rows.notes: 59 strict successes / 217 scored. Separate single-seed pilot with disclosed runtime recovery and a launch-budget exception.

rows.protocol: High effort · 10 trials/persona · seeds 100–109 · Responses-compatible API · 5 requests / 64 skills · 150 simulated seconds
rows.notes: 318 strict successes / 2,170 scored. The 1,099 policy errors count as failures; scored coverage does not imply simulator completion.

provenance.evidenceSnapshot: Derived counts are included in the public downloadable data; access to the private paper source is not required to inspect these counts.
provenance.sourceMethod: Displayed point estimates follow the current CoRL paper figure imported from Overleaf. Five archived strict report files were SHA-256-verified and their success counts and task-balanced means independently recomputed as archived evidence. Those archive checks do not independently recompute the paper's revised Astra high or Gemini points; no matching current Gemini trial-count bundle is included.
provenance.definition: Native persona-goal success, physical nonfixture evidence, valid and faithful execution, no timeout and no controller error. Scored policy errors fail.
provenance.aggregation: Mean observed trials within each observed persona, then mean observed personas within each task, then mean of all 100 tasks. This differs from pooled episode success.
provenance.missingData: Infrastructure errors remain unscored. Three entirely unobserved Opus API personas are excluded from the conditional task means; all 100 tasks have some observed data.
provenance.rounding: Paper-display percentages are rounded to one decimal using decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; full precision and rational rates remain in evidence.
provenance.scoreMeaning: These are complete privileged assisted policy systems, not raw vision-only model inference.
provenance.sourceDescription: Current CoRL paper strict-success leaderboard, including Gemini 4 at 30.4%. The private source is identified by its immutable revision and figure hash; archived trial counts retain their own provenance.
